source_snapshot.procedure:
【Before Test】
    1. Check that the SUT configuration (e.g., hardware, firmware, drivers, etc.) matches the specifications/recipe definition.
    2. Clear logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.).

    【During Test】
    Enter BMC Web UI -> Select "Hardware status" > Click tab "Inventory and LEDs" then check the Chassis information and detail information

    【After Test】
    1. Collect test results and photos, and save them to specific folders.
    2. Check if there are unexpected logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.) generate after test.
source_snapshot.criteria: Data should be readable and correct.

deepseek_columns.ai_logs_output: return FULL pretty-printed JSON from /redfish/v1/Chassis/UBB (UBB chassis) so user can read/diff against SPEC for "UBB". No RISK (read-only).

historical_reviews.deepseek: YES assumes that acronym UBB uniquely maps to /Chassis/UBB, weakens TLS and samples four properties without complete topology, IPMI, UI or status-freshness proof.
historical_reviews.gpt_v2: REQUIRES PACKAGE / USER CONFIRMATION / CHANGED requires vendor-defined UBB meaning/topology, complete identity and separate live Status evaluation under no-mutation controls.
historical_reviews.round_02: Entry 966/2291 accepts the assumed UBB URI with only a generic gate.
historical_reviews.related_source_cases: UBB_FPGA is a firmware subcomponent and FRU_SYS is system-level inventory; neither proves the exact UBB assembly identity.
historical_reviews.v3_1: ED-33 keeps WebUI/IPMI evidence; ED-34 permits approved collectors; ED-35 preserves identity/topology/status coverage; ED-36 treats UBB mapping/reference as readiness.

original_test_intent: Verify the UBB component's BMC inventory information is readable and correct for the selected platform.
original_method: Define UBB for the platform, bind its physical topology to the exact chassis/API and optional IPMI object, collect complete protected read-only identity and separately timed live Status, then reconcile with WebUI and the Project build reference.
manual_activity: The owner defines the UBB acronym, physical instance, expected identity and Status semantics. The agent may collect read-only evidence; topology disputes and final verdict remain engineer-owned.
safety_requirements: Do not write FRU, change power, reset or reboot.
Do not accept the UBB path solely from its acronym.
Use trusted transport and protected credentials.
Separate persistent identity from dynamic Status.
Stop on missing/duplicate UBB mapping or stale/unknown Status without automatic retry.
agent_execution_scope: Resolve UBB through the approved physical/topology map.
Collect complete redacted read-only API and approved IPMI inventory.
Capture WebUI detail and timestamped Status.
Compare static identity to build reference and Status to its separate policy.
Return evidence only with unchanged system state.
engineer_actions: Approve UBB definition, instance and mapping.
Review discrepancies and issue formal verdict.

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: Partial assumed read only; acronym/path identity, complete fields, IPMI/UI parity, trusted transport and Status freshness are missing.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Discover and bind the UBB through vendor topology, collect complete protected evidence, and evaluate static identity and live Status as separate checkpoints.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: UBB, WebUI inspection, Criterion and original time values remain preserved.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Use topology-bound complete UBB inventory parity with a separately timed Status checkpoint under no-mutation controls.
modernized_recommendation.applicable_platform: The vendor-defined UBB instance in the selected build.
modernized_recommendation.supported_version: Record BMC, schema and IPMI decoder versions.
modernized_recommendation.official_reference: Vendor UBB topology/FRU definition and Project build/health matrix.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds exact acronym/topology resolution, complete protected evidence and live/static separation while retaining WebUI validation.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: A four-property API sample is partial and readable Status does not prove topology or complete health.
modernized_recommendation.required_inputs: UBB map, full field baseline and Status policy.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: An ambiguous acronym can select the wrong component, and cached Status may appear healthy despite stale telemetry.

project_override_considerations: Alternate collectors require engineer-approved UBB identity/topology, equivalent fields and freshness, and explicit accounting for uncovered WebUI/IPMI coverage.
expected_evidence: UBB definition, physical topology and resource mapping
Complete raw redacted inventory with timestamps
Static field matrix plus separate Status/freshness assessment

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Master has one broad UBB inventory purpose; acronym and expected-field ambiguity are missing readiness details rather than competing instructions.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The inventory goal is clear enough for review; platform UBB definition and expected values are Project readiness inputs.

comparison_to_prior_reviews.deepseek: Adds vendor topology, complete parity and Status freshness instead of trusting an acronym URI.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.gpt_v2: Independently agrees with hybrid classification and no-mutation boundary.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.round_02: Adds exact identity and live/static gates absent from direct-run treatment.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.related_source_cases: Keeps UBB assembly coverage distinct from UBB FPGA firmware and system chassis FRU.

review_improvement: Makes the ambiguous UBB label traceable to an actual component and prevents a partial or stale response from passing full inventory correctness.
independent_technical_reasoning: UBB is not a universal Redfish resource name and can mean different assemblies by platform. Correctness therefore starts with vendor topology; persistent identity and live Status also have different authorities and timing, so they cannot be collapsed into one four-field check.
